evidence: Modifies core block-index management structures in src/chain.h and src/chain.cpp to enforce non-null invariants.
rationale: This PR refactors CChain vector storage to use std::reference_wrapper<CBlockIndex> and changes functions to pass CBlockIndex by reference where non-null invariants hold. Described by the author as a 'janitorial refactor' for 'slight improvement in code quality, maintainability and robustness', it does not fix bugs, alter consensus, or affect runtime validation behavior.
